steps.note: 部屋の出口から居間の入口まで。畳の上なので少し速めでも輪は青
steps.noteEn: To the living-room doorway; on tatami the ring stays blue even a bit faster

steps.note: いびきが鳴った！今のうちにギシッ板ごと速足で右へ
steps.noteEn: Snore! Hurry right over the creaky board while it covers me

steps.note: ギシッで父さんのゲージが少し上がった。いびきが止んだので止まって待つ
steps.noteEn: The creak nudged Dad's gauge. Snoring stopped, so I freeze

steps.note: またいびき。輪が青いうちに右へ走り、台所の入口へ
steps.noteEn: Snoring again: run right while the ring is blue, into the kitchen doorway

steps.note: 輪が黄色の間は待つ。次のいびきで右へ、上の台所へ
steps.noteEn: Wait while the ring is yellow; on the next snore go right and up into the kitchen

steps.note: 父さんがむにゃっと寝がえり。台所はしのび足でプリンへ
steps.noteEn: Dad stirred. Tiptoe to the pudding

steps.note: たんすをよけて右から回りこみ、プリンを取る
steps.noteEn: Around the cupboard on the right to the pudding

steps.note: プリンを取った。袋のカサッ。帰りもいびきを待つ
steps.noteEn: Got the pudding (crinkle). Will wait for snores on the way back too

steps.note: 台所をしのび足で入口まで戻る
steps.noteEn: Tiptoe back to the kitchen doorway

steps.note: 輪が青くなるのを待ち、いびきに合わせて左へ一気に
steps.noteEn: Wait for a blue ring, then dash left on the snore

steps.note: 父さんのゲージが半分を超えた。息をひそめてゲージが下がるのを待つ
steps.noteEn: Dad's gauge passed half. Holding my breath for it to fall

steps.note: いびきに合わせてギシッ板を越え、部屋へ駆けこむ
steps.noteEn: Cross the creaky board on a snore and dash into my room

steps.note: 父さんが起きて居間を見回すが、もう部屋の中。ふとんへ
steps.noteEn: Dad sits up and scans the living room, but I'm already in my room. Into the futon

steps.note: 父さんの視線が戸口から部屋の中までのびてくる！あと一歩でふとん
steps.noteEn: Dad's gaze reaches through the doorway into my room! One more step to the futon
